description:
Warhammer 40k: Mechanicus is Bulwark Studio's turn-based dungeon crawler game based on Game Workshop's Warhammer 40k universe. Imagine Warhammer 40k meets X-com!

The game pits the Adeptus Mechanicus against Necrons. You'll play the role of Magos Dominus Faustinius on his expedition to newly rediscovered planet of Silva Tenebris.
